CVE-2026-110257.title: OW2 ASM 5.0 before 9.11 contains an excessive memory allocation v ...
CVE-2026-110257.description: OW2 ASM 5.0 before 9.11 contains an excessive memory allocation vulnerability in ClassReader.readBootstrapMethodsAttribute() that sizes an int array from num_bootstrap_methods without validating attribute_length. Attackers can supply a crafted class file of about 100 bytes that forces roughly 2 GB allocation, causing an OutOfMemoryError that crashes the JVM or consuming thread.

CVE-2026-110258.title: OW2 ASM 3.0 before 9.11 contains an excessive memory allocation v ...
CVE-2026-110258.description: OW2 ASM 3.0 before 9.11 contains an excessive memory allocation vulnerability in Label.addSubroutineRetSuccessors() that fails to enforce the single-RET-per-JSR rule. Attackers can supply a crafted invalid class file with multiple RET instructions for one JSR, triggering a roughly 2 GB allocation that crashes the JVM.

CVE-2026-110260.title: OW2 ASM 3.0 before 9.11 contains a quadratic memory allocation vu ...
CVE-2026-110260.description: OW2 ASM 3.0 before 9.11 contains a quadratic memory allocation vulnerability in MethodWriter.computeMaxStackAndLocal() and computeAllFrames() when using COMPUTE_MAXS or COMPUTE_FRAMES. Attackers can supply a crafted class file with thousands of overlapping exception handlers, causing excessive Edge allocations and an OutOfMemoryError that crashes the JVM.

CVE-2026-110261.title: OW2 ASM 3.0 before 9.11 contains a denial of service vulnerabilit ...
CVE-2026-110261.description: OW2 ASM 3.0 before 9.11 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows attackers to exhaust CPU by supplying crafted class files processed with ClassWriter.COMPUTE_FRAMES. Attackers can craft methods that make the unbounded MethodWriter.computeAllFrames() fix point algorithm converge slowly, tying up transforming threads for unbounded time.

CVE-2026-104721.title: Path-traversal vulnerability in QOS.CH Sarl Logback-classic on Ja ...
CVE-2026-104721.description:
Path-traversal vulnerability in QOS.CH Sarl Logback-classic on Java (logback-classic module) allows path-traversal vulnerability. More specifically, an 
MDC-based discriminator value flows unsanitized into a nested 
FileAppender path, letting an attacker who influences that MDC value 
(e.g. via an HTTP header)
 create and append log files outside the intended directory. 


This issue affects Logback-classic: from 0.9.14 through 1.6.4.  This vulnerability is similar to CVE-2026-19880 but involves other attack techniques.
